# sources/storage-engines/wiredtiger/test/3rdparty/testscenarios-0.4/MANIFEST.in

Purpose: source-distribution manifest for the vendored `testscenarios` 0.4 package. It ensures license files, project notes, build helper files, news, and documentation examples are included when building an sdist.

Important APIs, types, and functions: declarative distutils/setuptools directives include `.bzrignore`, `Apache-2.0`, `BSD`, `COPYING`, `GOALS`, `HACKING`, `MANIFEST.in`, `Makefile`, `NEWS`, and `doc/*.py`.

Control flow: setuptools reads this file during sdist creation after `setup.py` metadata is evaluated. Each `include` directive adds a literal file or globbed documentation Python file into the archive.

State and persistence: no runtime state. The persistent output is the package archive file list generated by packaging tools.

Dependencies and integration points: integrates with `setup.py` and the Python packaging sdist command. The included license files are relevant because the code is dual-licensed.

Risks and test signals: packaging can omit the README because it is not explicitly listed here, though setuptools may include it by convention. Test signals are `python setup.py sdist` contents and downstream ability to run documentation examples from an unpacked release.
